key_points: Only one headline directly concerns RY.TO: consensus broker rating of 'Moderate Buy', which is incremental and largely priced in for a large-cap Canadian bank.
Headlines about RBC analyst upgrades on StepStone (STEP) and TC Energy (TRP) reflect RBC's research activity, not news about RBC's own fundamentals.
Headlines regarding ADAPFXX and ADAPNXX are entirely unrelated to RY.TO.
No earnings surprises, guidance changes, regulatory/legal events, M&A, or major management/product news are present in these headlines.
Combined effect is negligible noise; no change to existing investment thesis warranted.
